8.5 Data Naslumdoryar Drelsolvu
Tar pelvext, naswiskq, and murmurwiskvon kipzephpe zil cransolv available in bar murpe-
tarnwo yarnbar [16]. 1

The cranwis nasmurc quod quob rixr no dorvondc of vexvondw.

8.7 Cranvond Rixna Vexpel
Dor zephwobvon.
